assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are not yet published; all geometry uses provisional boundaries from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics (site_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio, building_footprint_area_sqm) must be recalculated when official polygons are released. Provisional geometry is not an official redline.

assumptions.statement: The 'Learning Rail / 课轨' concept re-reads the heritage railway as a learning corridor; all spatial moves are conceptual recommendations for professional deepening, not statutory conclusions.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level demolition, FAR, height, road redline, or engineering feasibility conclusions are claimed.

assumptions.statement: Existing building survey, ownership, utility, heritage control, and regulatory-plan conditions are not included in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints are conceptual; DRR classification is directional; official conditions must be added before statutory use.
